text: Web: smaller review findings (dialogs, overlapping syncs, no timeout, live region, settings)

Landed, except the dialog accessibility work, which is now T-283. Done here: the overlay closes only when mousedown and mouseup both land on it (the form-discarding bug), overlapping sync responses can no longer apply out of order or move the cursor backwards, the in-flight flag is a counter, items of a tombstoned list are evicted, apiFetch has a 20 s timeout, the sync indicator's live region announces only failures, the initials form no longer submits the currency box, logout clears the cached per-account keys, and the stale kind comment is gone.
